text.tspan: C2-E02 · Exact integral of the prescribed profile
E_L = 2πF₀ ∫ r e^(−2r²/w²) dr = (πw²F₀/2) ∫ e^(−x) dx = π w² F₀ / 2 (x = 2r²/w²)
Summing annular rings 2πr dr reproduces the closed form; the total is finite although the Gaussian never ends.
Ring weights and cumulative energy from Eq. C2-E02.
